title: OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications 2026 (ASI01–ASI10)
disclaimer: Self-assessment mapping of Amber's governance-layer controls, NOT a certification or third-party audit. Amber is a static, non-runtime layer; most ASI risks require a runtime control plane (e.g. microsoft/agent-governance-toolkit) and are honestly marked out-of-scope.

risks.title: Agent Goal Hijack
risks.risk: Adversarial input overrides an agent's intended goal.
risks.note: Requires runtime inbound-prompt filtering; Amber does not sit in the agent's execution path.

risks.title: Tool Misuse and Exploitation
risks.risk: An agent invokes tools/commands in dangerous ways.
amberControls: governed.command policy gate denies dangerous commands (deny-wins, default-deny)
risks.note: Covers the command a governed loop may run; no runtime wrapping of arbitrary tool calls.

risks.title: Identity and Privilege Abuse
risks.risk: Agents acquire privileges beyond their role.
risks.note: Requires runtime identity / RBAC / PII redaction.

risks.title: Agentic Supply Chain
risks.risk: Compromised tools or sub-agents inject malicious behaviour.
amberControls: rules.json allow-list pins the exact commands a governed loop may run
risks.note: No SBOM or dependency vulnerability scanning.

risks.title: Unexpected Code Execution
risks.risk: Agent-driven paths achieve arbitrary code execution.
risks.note: Requires runtime static analysis / sandboxing of agent code, which Amber does not perform.

risks.title: Memory and Context Poisoning
risks.risk: Persistent state is manipulated to corrupt future decisions.
amberControls: hash-chain ledger gives tamper detection for governance/execution records
risks.note: Detection, not prevention; no memory-store sandbox. See ledger limitation in the design spec.

risks.title: Insecure Inter-Agent Communication
risks.note: Requires a runtime trust-gate / DID verification.

risks.title: Cascading Agent Failures
risks.risk: One failure cascades across an agent system.
risks.note: Requires runtime circuit breakers / rate limiting. Amber's hardStops are declarative, not enforced at runtime.

risks.title: Human-Agent Trust Exploitation
risks.risk: Humans are misled into trusting unsafe agent actions.
amberControls: approval gate forces an explicit human sign-off before any governed execution
tamper-evident ledger records who approved and what was executed
risks.note: Governance-time human control, not UI-level guardrails.

risks.title: Rogue Agents
risks.risk: An agent behaves maliciously or goes out of control.
